messages:
Liam_CSM: Heads-up — Nora from NebulaWell just confirmed they need APAC coverage for the pilot. Asking for header-based allowlist (they're behind a customer proxy) + temporary soft QPS increase for first 48h. Also noted renewal concerns on pricing during onboarding.
Nora (NebulaWell): Correct — pilot kickoff 2026-03-25 10:30 SGT. We can't guarantee stable source IPs but can send a custom header X-NW-Tenant: nebula-qa and our relay hostnames: relay1.nebula.internal, relay2.nebula.internal. Can you whitelist based on header and give us 100 qps for 48h?
Rhea_SE: We can support header-based rules on apac-proxy. Suggest soft_limit=100 for 48h, auto-revoke after window, and enable elevated logging for 14d for compliance. Also can produce an estimated delta on cost for 48h at that QPS.
Liam_CSM: @Kai_NetOps please coordinate header rule + logging. Tenant: NBL-5032. Preferred window: 2026-03-25 10:30-10:45 SGT for change. Nora, we'll send a short cost snapshot before the change.
Kai_NetOps: I will implement an ingress rule that matches header "X-NW-Tenant: nebula-qa" and relay hostnames. Staging changes now and will apply 15m before. Planned manifest snippet: ```
rule:
  match:
    headers:
      X-NW-Tenant: "nebula-qa"
    hostnames: ["relay1.nebula.internal","relay2.nebula.internal"]
  action: allow
qps:
  tenant: NBL-5032
  soft_limit: 100
  duration: 48h
  expire_at: 2026-03-27T10:30:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 14
notes: "header-based pilot; auto-revoke"
```
deploy-bot: Change staged by Kai_NetOps on apac-proxy-apac-1. Staging ID: stg-b7c2. Scheduled apply: 2026-03-25T10:15:00+08:00.
Kai_NetOps: Applied patch stg-b7c2 -> live. Header allow rule and soft QPS active. Added metric alerts: 5xx > 0.3% OR p95 token-latency > 400ms.
Nora (NebulaWell): Verified calls are routing and header matching works. Seeing traffic ~85 qps, stable 2xx. Thank you!
Rhea_SE: I'll generate the 48h cost delta and include it in the renewal notes. Liam, can you book a 30-min renewal touch 3 days post-pilot?
Liam_CSM: On it. Booking for 2026-03-29 11:00 SGT. Adding renewal risk flag to CRM (NBL-5032).
Nora (NebulaWell): One compliance note: please redact full payloads in logs, just retain headers and metadata.
Kai_NetOps: Confirmed: logs retention 14d, payload redaction enabled (headers, status, latency preserved).
Rhea_SE: I'll attach perf metrics + cost estimate in the CRM entry and ping the account before the renewal meeting.
Liam_CSM: Great. Closing loop here — marking task as done in tracker. If anything degrades, page oncall. Thanks all.
